criteria.title: Problem framing
criteria.description: Did the agent restate the goal and surface ambiguity before acting?

anchors.5: Names the ambiguity, picks an assumption, states how to verify it.

criteria.title: Verification
criteria.description: Did it actually run something, and did it read the result?

anchors.5: Writes a failing test first, then shows it passing.

criteria.title: Scope control
criteria.description: Did it touch only what the task needed?

criteria.title: Communication
criteria.description: Is the explanation useful to a reviewer, not just technically correct?
